items.markdown:
You can estimate your blood alcohol concentration using an online tool like the [BAC Calculator](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX733a0D-AxmcyXZP8-u2QFmqcSne7bb8fxHFL6eiWGdByicFq3u95IMefIKvzr_j8N6WfV2_hgJf9DDEbMEBBnmGfm762h625l5Xgd1rYif70l4uIMS6EilmGe9mbzSw2g1vOAiM) or [DrinkFox](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXpkGcMv6h484ggWmcdtgbtICOA44lLKcf68RJQcSZJW843HEbn7Np3o3hafSrjkXDUOhAzi0S0ui2aMBSGqcdG5mwCKg56754U-oJMxXZ72utgsBBmNp2L5WyNI0jc4bHvGxfmg) , which factor in sex, body weight, drinks consumed, and time elapsed.⁠Calculator.net  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX733a0D-AxmcyXZP8-u2QFmqcSne7bb8fxHFL6eiWGdByicFq3u95IMefIKvzr_j8N6WfV2_hgJf9DDEbMEBBnmGfm762h625l5Xgd1rYif70l4uIMS6EilmGe9mbzSw2g1vOAiM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXpkGcMv6h484ggWmcdtgbtICOA44lLKcf68RJQcSZJW843HEbn7Np3o3hafSrjkXDUOhAzi0S0ui2aMBSGqcdG5mwCKg56754U-oJMxXZ72utgsBBmNp2L5WyNI0jc4bHvGxfmg)

### How BAC Is Estimated

Most calculators use a variation of the Widmark formula to estimate blood alcohol content (BAC):⁠alcohol.indianapolis.iu.edu  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXfX7LXk4ewPiaIR1brByV80kpYZQ3_1QnLiBSTO2aWIYPxMDCFXSeMwZyuoaYTyGRu1TqDZJmEV3alCDBF3ijV4z6EQh8SDDiZK2XV_FIr6s1kFQwe-Mr10PCnTB89WPhPoc__wZc39tCwtyt5s6T)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXpkGcMv6h484ggWmcdtgbtICOA44lLKcf68RJQcSZJW843HEbn7Np3o3hafSrjkXDUOhAzi0S0ui2aMBSGqcdG5mwCKg56754U-oJMxXZ72utgsBBmNp2L5WyNI0jc4bHvGxfmg)

- **Alcohol consumed:** Based on drink volume and alcohol percentage (ABV). A standard U.S. drink has about 0.6 fl oz (14 grams) of pure alcohol—roughly 12 oz of 5% beer, 5 oz of 12% wine, or 1.5 oz of 40% (80-proof) spirits.
- **Body weight & sex:** Water distribution and body composition affect how alcohol dilutes in the body.
- **Time:** The body eliminates alcohol at a rough average rate of about 0.015% to 0.016% per hour.⁠Alcohol.org  +5[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXwHEIkXXcm8grQhv19WSrgnQqZxzoZv4lIJsTs-dYC1yMmVB_-vwWuea0yyDpOp3yaFkBxqUK7qSLh8VEFOhjnKCE1KHcpfeASHt4XGUYq-iauuaF5tAaa5YOXfkQMIX)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX733a0D-AxmcyXZP8-u2QFmqcSne7bb8fxHFL6eiWGdByicFq3u95IMefIKvzr_j8N6WfV2_hgJf9DDEbMEBBnmGfm762h625l5Xgd1rYif70l4uIMS6EilmGe9mbzSw2g1vOAiM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXcE7MWHbF2zNiBOVGqP_K12O7yvBnfUY7r3ydtD7nqNu2FJk8TYgIhfjU8pvdjAH9QBYLc5F-lsjxaSgcYHALKn1IKzcO7jNy4uoxjgSiX5CQTc1CLj58D7TAQLmlZ4WW_H04ThMon-joAovUfEHUX4mjHz4t8Pr0)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXfX7LXk4ewPiaIR1brByV80kpYZQ3_1QnLiBSTO2aWIYPxMDCFXSeMwZyuoaYTyGRu1TqDZJmEV3alCDBF3ijV4z6EQh8SDDiZK2XV_FIr6s1kFQwe-Mr10PCnTB89WPhPoc__wZc39tCwtyt5s6T)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXpkGcMv6h484ggWmcdtgbtICOA44lLKcf68RJQcSZJW843HEbn7Np3o3hafSrjkXDUOhAzi0S0ui2aMBSGqcdG5mwCKg56754U-oJMxXZ72utgsBBmNp2L5WyNI0jc4bHvGxfmg)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z6d_5YCcS0U)

### Important Limitations

- **Estimates only:** Food intake, medications, metabolism, health, and drinking speed all change real-world BAC.
- **Legal & safety limits:** In the U.S., the legal driving limit for adults 21 and older is **0.08%** in most states (0.05% in Utah), and zero-tolerance or lower limits apply to drivers under 21. Calculators cannot reliably determine whether you are safe or legal to drive.⁠Calculator.net  +6[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX733a0D-AxmcyXZP8-u2QFmqcSne7bb8fxHFL6eiWGdByicFq3u95IMefIKvzr_j8N6WfV2_hgJf9DDEbMEBBnmGfm762h625l5Xgd1rYif70l4uIMS6EilmGe9mbzSw2g1vOAiM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXcE7MWHbF2zNiBOVGqP_K12O7yvBnfUY7r3ydtD7nqNu2FJk8TYgIhfjU8pvdjAH9QBYLc5F-lsjxaSgcYHALKn1IKzcO7jNy4uoxjgSiX5CQTc1CLj58D7TAQLmlZ4WW_H04ThMon-joAovUfEHUX4mjHz4t8Pr0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXwHEIkXXcm8grQhv19WSrgnQqZxzoZv4lIJsTs-dYC1yMmVB_-vwWuea0yyDpOp3yaFkBxqUK7qSLh8VEFOhjnKCE1KHcpfeASHt4XGUYq-iauuaF5tAaa5YOXfkQMIX)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXJ35mtQ2L58x9KvDLkRH_wXxCHCo8DtlkLXQIvvO262Wud5q0g-4AOxXINFSNmyRuyOjitONAL6avMfRWMyUCMmS-q8kmAN8tQLQGsyvqSTYbCbwo3riKU1LZtr7cyraG3YGsGDc)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX1wAsKEi_CR2nQSsUueUJcWepP_YygOii5odXZT7sZi5Z259oyZEUlR_omNn4pvTOyW1jcxdxVGuDHATV3XYrmNvF_ah6E6caihT-R9akjORqb6GqZZwSGj0NK4Xj0Cz_5iDxk_9AB0scZUUOczZ8aREiXw)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXgHEIkXXJmrhCIj__ihHp1gjCs8us5B0RA5dGTToAzckMrTXjP-2XMCijSvK_8zn_9TASRC-iv0RHXps-NxmJkQNFb0yt6795IRqCPYdPZO_EYJnyX6cGPdIEGRJIFU)[[7]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXpkGcMv6h484ggWmcdtgbtICOA44lLKcf68RJQcSZJW843HEbn7Np3o3hafSrjkXDUOhAzi0S0ui2aMBSGqcdG5mwCKg56754U-oJMxXZ72utgsBBmNp2L5WyNI0jc4bHvGxfmg)
